summary: XCHG Limited, a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting that President Aatish V Patel ceased serving as President effective September 7, 2026, and was appointed General Manager of its wholly-owned U.S. subsidiary, XCharge Energy USA Inc. An amendment to his offer letter, dated September 4, 2026, formalizes the transition. The reassignment reflects strategic focus on strengthening U.S. operations. This is an internal management reshuffle, not a forced termination or external hire; it may signal operational shift. Watch for further executive changes or strategic U.S. expansion moves.
